rules.sentence: Multiple lines of evidence indicate that this new disease, termed variant Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease (vCJD) is a consequence of exposure to the prion disease of cattle, called bovine spongiform encephalopathy.
Also, there is now documentation of transmission by blood transfusion.
